scope: One remaining native milestone: independent public certificate, compact honest-owner client context, resource/trust handoff and scoped model lemmas. Known supporting assurance, no new HE, native evaluation, timing or production approval.

Implement a bounded checker independent of the optimizer and HE implementations; validate the authoritative selected graph/effects, full actual-prime/common-integer coverage and conservative phase/terminal guards

Implement and test a compact signed owner descriptor linking complete ordered IDs, logical dataset revision, mode-specific snapshot/key/policy/certificate binding and the permitted cache premise, without requiring HE enrollment on the client
Publish owned/resident/scratch lifetime accounting with explicit unknowns and model/kernel/native refinement boundaries; write the pre-Q77 security-feasibility and early claim-to-prior decision cards

selected_contract.profiles: Only the three retained owner-canonical Q120 geometries N16/d3/t11/eta1, N32/d5/t19/eta1 and N16384/d512/t1031/eta21; exact retained Q/P/ordered primes are pinned inputs, not freshly selected parameters
selected_contract.owner_origin: Honest binary index/query encoding, independent OS-backed bounded samplers, ternary HE secret support, correct key and seed basis. Authentication binds bytes but proves none of these private semantics.
selected_contract.integer_effect: One canonical 120-bit whole-Q source in [0,Q), four radix-30 digits shared by both actual primes; complete invertible negacyclic NTT vectors, never independent per-prime preimages or a free expanded query
selected_contract.graph_effect: One original predivided packed query, complete canonical expansion schedule, all feature/group products including the middle tensor cross term, one canonical relinearization per group, complete deterministic Q-to-P codec. No response-selected graph or bounds.
selected_contract.output_effect: All exact distances, complete zero feature/record tails, complete frame and ordered-ID coverage. Rank (distance, original row ordinal); numeric IDs are labels.
selected_contract.authority: Certificate checking is public static validation, not a private-release capability or attestation. Actual runtime equality, current owner context, request/frame binding and trusted nonrollback at-most-once controller remain additional premises.
selected_contract.client_binding: A trusted owner signs a compact context after validating the certificate. Owner-declared logical equivalence of cache and HE views is explicit; no public ciphertext-equivalence or plaintext-membership proof is claimed.
selected_contract.custody: HE secret stays owner/client; local public checker may have an attestation signer only in a later deployment. Exact modes have no randomized challenge. Unimplemented randomized/public-after-commit or query-confidential placements are not certificate options.
selected_contract.resources: Inventory complete owned inputs, resident preparation, dynamic arrays, codec/framing/parser copies, acquisition, update invalidation and any unknown native allocator/Python/crypto overhead. Canonical counts and process RSS never certify exact native stage peaks.

proof_toolchain.selected: leanprover/lean4 v4.34.1, official Linux x86_64 distribution, core/Std only initially
proof_toolchain.freeze_before_model_implementation: Official asset metadata, full archive SHA256, extracted executable/dependency inventory and --version receipt. No global/home installation or unpinned rolling toolchain.
proof_toolchain.scope: Kernel-checked selected arithmetic guards and explicit abstract representation/authority lemmas. Not a mechanized RLWE security reduction, C++ compiler proof, sampler/side-channel audit or novel general type system.
proof_toolchain.acceptance: No sorry/admit or user-added axioms; publish #print axioms output and the remaining semantic/refinement premises. Do not hide trust in native_decide or compiler computation inside a proof claim.
